headline: Possible decommissioning of the CNG fueling station, a draft residential recycling collection policy, and the GMT Micromobility and ADA Study.
summary: The meeting will discuss the GMT Micromobility and ADA Study and a draft policy on residential recycling collection. It will also consider possible decommissioning of the CNG fueling station, with possible action.
